note: ST-F19's post-reduction figures. Rendered-in-branch, NOT visible-without-scrolling — that half is human-only (ST-F20 AC 7). Regenerate with: node tests/density-baseline.mjs

supersedes.why: The ST-F18 figures here were measured with a chained-guard reader bug: `{a && b && (<jsx>)}` evaluated only `a`, kept the block whatever `b` was, and counted `b` as a word of visible copy. Fixed in tests/lib/density.mjs during ST-F19 and pinned by a standing test. The correction removes one phantom word from every scene (the word `capture`, from App.tsx's TabBar guard) and removes the unanswered-retry card from scene (b), which is not rendered in that state. No screen changed to produce this delta; the instrument did.

correctedBaseline.why: The corrected ST-F18 baseline, i.e. the same screens measured with the chained-guard reader fixed but before ST-F19 touched UnitGate. This is the 'before' column ST-F19's percentages are computed against. Scene (b) is unchanged by ST-F19 by design: the owner narrowed the density work to the unit-entry screen, so the chat empty state was deliberately not restyled.
